admission.question: How can I enroll?
admission.answer: You can enroll by talking to one of our counselors. Would you like us to arrange a callback?

admission.question: Is there any eligibility?
admission.answer: Eligibility depends on the course. Please select the course you are interested in.

classes.question: Are classes live?
classes.answer: Yes, all our sessions are conducted live online.

classes.question: Are recordings available?
classes.answer: Yes, recordings are provided for enrolled students.

placement.question: Do you provide placement assistance?
placement.answer: Yes, we provide placement assistance including resume reviews, mock interviews and interview preparation.

certificate.question: Will I receive a certificate?
certificate.answer: Yes, certificates are provided after successful completion of the course.

fees.question: Can I pay in EMI?
fees.answer: EMI options are available for selected courses. Please contact our counselor for details.

support.question: How can I contact support?
support.answer: You can raise your concern here or request a callback from our support team.
